verdict.rationale: Linear's Loops let users describe a recurring job in plain language and run it on a schedule or in response to workspace events, including changes to initiatives, projects, and cycles. Documented examples include a loop that updates the launch plan and posts to Slack when a target date changes, and the agent can investigate and attempt fixes on newly reported issues without a human prompting it. Missing for 10: in-depth docs beyond changelog snippets (full trigger list, run history/monitoring, failure handling), and independent or hands-on corroboration of loops running reliably.
